purpose: Second frozen GeoFM control for the completed Sen12 S12q OLMo/raw benchmark

input.cohort: Sen12 S12q: the same 12 label-independent selected observations used by P2/P3/P4
input.source_shape: 10 bands x 12 timesteps x 128 x 128 pixels
input.normalization: Each S2 digital number is divided by 10000 with zero shift, exactly as pinned upstream source.
input.month_encoding: Pass the exact selected calendar-month vector with shape [pixel_batch, 12]. Upstream month_to_tensor preserves a 2-D month tensor; do not pass a scalar start month.
input.latlon: Derive WGS84 pixel coordinates from each NetCDF CRS and x/y coordinates. Do not use center_lat/center_lon attributes directly because the contract audit found projected values.
input.spatial_output: 128 channels x 128 x 128 native pixel grid

registered_readouts.primary_common_grid: Non-overlapping channel-wise 4x4 arithmetic mean pooling to 128 channels x 32 x 32, then the same spatial decoder/upscale path as P4.
registered_readouts.sensitivity_native_grid: Keep 128 channels x 128 x 128. Use the C1b-native decoder: the same trainable layers as C1a/P4 (1x1 projection 128->128, two conv_bn blocks 128->64->32, 1x1 head) but perform both conv blocks at 128x128 with no spatial interpolation. Assert an exact 128x128 input and output. This keeps trainable parameters matched while changing spatial support and compute. This decoder detail was fixed after C1a was visible, so C1b remains a retrospective product-level sensitivity, not a replacement primary comparison.
registered_readouts.forbidden: Do not choose a pooling rule after seeing C1 performance; do not use the native-grid result alone to claim OlmoEarth-specific superiority.

decoder_and_evaluation.decoder: Primary C1a uses fixed 4x4 mean pooling and the same P4 spatial path with cin changed 768 to 128. C1b uses the parameter-matched P4native path declared in registered_readouts: no spatial upsampling, exact 128x128 input/output, separately reported as a retrospective native-grid sensitivity.

evidence_boundary.probe: 8/8 feasibility checks passed, including deterministic 16-pixel encode.
evidence_boundary.normalization_and_commit: Resolved by byte-identical comparison with the pinned upstream commit.

completed_c1b_2026_09_02.interpretation: Native resolution improves the Presto macro over C1a but does not change its ordering against P4 or P2. C1b remains a retrospective product sensitivity.

remaining: Resolve the raw-baseline recipe audit before opening low-budget outcomes.
Seal nested subset manifests and run the multi-subset-seed source-label-budget audit.
Run the first untouched OlmoEarth-vs-Presto transfer on Korea or another unopened external cohort.
evidence_boundary.interpretation: C1a and C1b show that the M65 gain did not extend to this matched frozen Presto control under the S12q event contract. Native-grid C1b weakens the pooling explanation but does not establish universal OlmoEarth superiority because Presto is outside its native 12-month use case and the comparison is retrospective. Common-grid C1a remains primary; native-grid C1b is a product sensitivity. The first sealed first-look OlmoEarth-vs-Presto transfer must be Korea or another unopened external cohort.
